title: Bluffton Library tracker shifts from total project budget to bid amount
reason: The January 19 packet itself explains the apparent shift: the $479,381 total consists of a $416,853 construction bid plus a $62,528 contingency. The May tracker’s $416,853 matches the bid amount exactly. This documented bid-versus-total-budget distinction is an innocent explanation shown in the records, so the apparent tracker change does not support an unexplained change lead. The packet does not establish whether contingency was unused or removed, but that uncertainty does not undo the explanation for the two figures.
